name: KCCableCo
old_description: KCCableCo specializes in low voltage, structured cabling, voice, data, access control, security systems, sound masking, video security cabling, IT equipment installations and IT smart hands. Our difference begins with highly skilled BICSI certified and technical staff that follows through with the most cost effective and efficient solutions to fit your needs and budget. Over the past ten years KCCableCo’s high integrity, quality workmanship and prompt responsiveness has earned the reputation of being one of the top low voltage and structured cabling solutions providers in the Kansas City Metro Area. When it comes to your low voltage and structured cabling needs, you can trust KCCableCo to make sure your project is a success.
about:
KCCableCo is based in Olathe, Kansas, and has provided low-voltage and structured cabling solutions across the Kansas City metropolitan area for over a decade. The company focuses on both existing buildings and new construction projects.

Its core services include structured cabling using Category 5e, 6, and 6e copper as well as fiber-optic and coaxial cable, all installed by BICSI-certified technicians and backed by a one-year workmanship warranty and up to a 20-year manufacturer warranty. The firm also designs and installs video security systems with monitoring, access-control systems for offices, medical facilities, schools, and apartment complexes, and enterprise wireless networks for venues such as stadiums and theaters. Additional offerings cover IT equipment installation and smart-hands support.

KCCableCo serves multi-family residential, retail, medical, industrial, and commercial clients. Past customers cited on its site include managed-service provider FireFly MSP, construction firm Lockmann Krane, electrical contractor Lightning Electric, manufacturer Stouse Manufacturing, and restaurant group PB&J Restaurant Group.

The company emphasizes its BICSI-certified staff, cost-effective design-build approach, and responsive project management as key differentiators.
